event_chain.summary: Misdelivery: download link to confidential documents sent to member of the public
Recipient refused to delete files without something in return (extortion)

summary: On 12 February 2026 a Dutch police officer responding to a man who offered images relevant to an investigation mistakenly sent him a download link to confidential police documents instead of an upload link. The 40-year-old man downloaded the files and, when told to stop and delete them, refused unless he received 'something in return'. Police arrested him on suspicion of computer trespass.
